persons.name: Nuscotnemeg

present_on_scene_date.note: Presence on the afternoon of 14 August 1812, read from the evidence below; no source takes a roll call that afternoon.

persons.note: Hostile leader; implicated in 1810 Illinois murders. Potawatomi. Fought and was badly wounded on the 15th (Wau-Bun); named a leader by Quaife and the Encyclopedia. 15 and 16 August: Badly wounded; carried off toward the Des Plaines by the 16th (Wau-Bun). Afterwards: Alive 1817, when Storrow met him at Chicago (Quaife). His daughter was Billy Caldwell's wife (Wau-Bun ch. XVII; Andreas p. 109).
